def transform(grid):
    # Mirror the lower pattern across the divider row, preserving the divider.
    mid = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if row and all(v == row[0] for v in row) and row[0] != 0)
    out = [r[:] for r in grid]
    for d in range(1, max(mid, len(grid)-mid-1)+1):
        a, b = mid-d, mid+d
        if a >= 0 and b < len(grid):
            out[a] = grid[b][:]
    return out
